rv.q: Michael Grandage could hardly have made a better start to his five-show West End season than with this joyous revival of Peter Nichols's 1977 play with music.
Privates on Parade is a lovely picture of the ways in which the ordinary business of military life is intertwined with agonies and absurdities.
Dominic Cooke's excellent cast, including Emma Fielding and Stuart McQuarrie, are teasing and riveting.

cn.t: Grandage's joyous revival wins praise for Russell Beale's scene-stealing performance as the flamboyant drag queen, though the production earns stronger enthusiasm from some critics than others for its mix of musical parody and colonial politics.
